name: Entity View Display Template Suggestions
description: Adds Twig template suggestions to an entity's render, toggled per entity view display via a third-party setting. Currently provides a single "bare" suggestion.
project_description:
This module aims to allow entity templates to get suggestions from the entity view display configuration. The goal is to allow to have generic templates not related to a view mode and to be able to configure if the view mode should use it or not.

Features: currently the module only allows to have a "bare" template suggestion.

Post-installation: after enabling the module, go on a view display configuration like "admin/structure/types/manage/page/display" and you will see a new "Template suggestions" configuration option.

Maintainer: Florent Torregrosa (Grimreaper).
